scope: Independent exact original-resolution pixel/source review of great-supper01-04; no imports or page changes.

entries.alt: A bald bearded servant gestures to a mustached man at a doorway, with a prepared meal visible in the courtyard behind him.
entries.caption: The servant announces that the supper is ready. Jesus begins the story with a prepared meal and an invitation to come.
findings: Full-resolution original inspected: bald reddish-bearded servant in green/beige distinct from dark-haired mustached invitee in blue/striped mantle. Faces/garments continue02.
Open-hand gesture and invitee doorframe grip coherent, reciprocal conversational gaze, natural restrained expressions. Prepared table visible but menu/architecture are artistic staging.
Luke14:16-17 supports readiness announcement. No named historical identity or invented reason for response assigned.

entries.alt: The same servant listens as the invited man raises one palm and gestures toward a cultivated field with his other hand.
entries.caption: An invited man gestures toward his field as he asks to be excused. This scene pictures the first refusal Jesus describes, before the invitation reaches others.
findings: Servant and same mustached invitee preserve01 identity. Raised refusing palm and extended field gesture have coherent fingers/wrists and no extra limbs.
Eyes meet with conversational seriousness; no villain caricature. Field and plants provide context, no oxen/wedding party or combined incidents.
Narrowed refs toLuke14:18 and recommended title toThe field excuse; only first excuse shown. No claim of exact crop/species, purchase document or private motive.

entries.alt: A servant welcomes three people at an open doorway; two older men hold wooden walking staffs, and a woman supports one man by the arm.
entries.caption: At the doorway, the servant welcomes a group into the waiting supper. Jesus describes the invitation reaching people in the streets and lanes who had not been at the center of the first guest list.
findings: Same servant recognizable at door, extending open welcoming arm. Three visitors distinct by face/hair/clothing; no duplicated faces.
Visible straight wooden supports are walking staffs, not underarm crutches. Woman hand/forearm assistance and older man staff grip plausible. Closed eyes do not establish clinical diagnosis.

Warm attention among servant and approaching people; modest period clothing, natural daylight/interior lamplight and coherent threshold. No cure, disability diagnosis, kinship or miraculous change asserted.
Luke14:21 gives widened streets/lanes invitation. Caption remains broad rather than pretending image demonstrates every category named in verse.

entries.alt: On a path beyond the town, the servant extends an open hand while a woman holding a basket and a seated older man with a staff look toward him.
entries.caption: The servant carries the invitation out beyond the town, meeting people along the way. The master's wish is that his house be filled, widening the welcome beyond those first invited.
findings: Servant retains bald face/reddish beard and green/beige clothes. Woman with basket and seated older man distinguishable from servant; open gesture is invitational, no grabbing or coercive contact.
Mutually directed gazes and expressions fit attentive invitation; basket handle grip, staff hand and open palm coherent. Photographic skin/fabric and warm outdoor light.
Luke14:23 roads/hedges setting illustrated without claim of precise geography. No added family relationship, forced attendance, conversion or final response.
